intro.title: Memoization Strategy
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React application that demonstrates memoization by comparing the performance of a regular component with a memoized one. You will learn the core concept of memoization, which is a technique to optimize React components by preventing unnecessary re-renders. The main technologies involved are React, TypeScript, and the React.memo higher-order component. By the end, you'll understand when and how to apply memoization to improve your app's efficiency.
intro.usecase: Memoization is essential in real-world React applications where expensive calculations or data transformations need to be cached. In financial dashboards, memoization prevents redundant calculations when filtering large datasets by date ranges or categories. E-commerce product filters use memoization to avoid re-sorting thousands of items on every user interaction. Data visualization components memoize chart data processing to maintain smooth performance during frequent updates. This pattern is crucial for maintaining responsive UIs in complex applications with heavy computational requirements.
